description: This source file defines the implementation of the Cell_SPM class, focusing on fitting cycling parameters of a battery cell, including setting OCV curves, initial concentrations, geometric parameters, and characterization parameters.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: A class representing a lithium-ion battery cell with methods to set its properties and parameters for modeling and fitting purposes.

methods.name: setOCVcurve
methods.description: Loads specified OCV curves from CSV files for the positive and negative electrodes.

methods.name: setInitialConcentration
methods.description: Sets the initial lithium concentration fractions in the cathode and anode based on maximum concentrations and fractions.

methods.name: setGeometricParameters
methods.description: Configures the geometric parameters of the cell, including capacity, surface area, volume fractions, and thicknesses.

methods.name: setCharacterisationParam
methods.description: Sets parameters related to the electrochemical and physical characterization of the cell, such as diffusion constants and reaction rate constants.
